Definition: to be foul, especially in a ceremial or moral sense (contaminated)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be unclean, become unclean, become impure; 1a) (Qal) to be or become unclean; 1a1) sexually; 1a2) religiously; 1a3) ceremonially; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to defile oneself, be defiled; 1b1a) sexually; 1b1b) by idolatry; 1b1c) ceremonially; 1b2) to be regarded as unclean; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to defile; 1c1a) sexually; 1c1b) religiously; 1c1c) ceremonially; 1c2) to pronounce unclean, declare unclean (ceremonially); 1c3) to profane (God's name); 1d) (Pual) to be defiled; 1e) (Hithpael) to be unclean; 1f) (Hothpael) to be defiled
